newsitem.title: CANADA: Inmet buys into Chile copper deal.
newsitem.headline: Inmet buys into Chile copper deal.

text.p: Inmet Mining Corp said on Thursday it entered into two agreements to give it an option to earn a 100 percent interest in the Chimborazo copper property in Chile.
The agreement was with Cyprus Amax Minerals Co and Agate Bay Resources Ltd, Inmet said.
Inmet said it could earn a 100 percent interest in the property by paying US$10 million over three years and if the option was exercised, an advanced royalty payment of at least US$35 million.
Cyprus would retain a royalty interest in the property.
Agate Bay will have the right to earn a 60 percent interest in the property, subject to reduction to 40 percent if Inmet decides to make certain payments, Inmet said.

Inmet and Agate Bay will fund expenditures under the Cyprus option agreement on a pro rata basis, with Inmet making the initial US$2 million option payment to Cyprus, and Agate Bay funding the first US$3 million of work on the property.
The companies are planning a substantial drill program to confirm and expand the resource, Inmet said.
The company said Chimborazo can be mined as an open pit with heap leaching on site.
